purpose: Define the minimum governed workflow for comparing results across independent tools and mechanism classes before a result may be treated as supported.

steps.name: define_observables
steps.description: Convert the target claim into measurable outputs that can be extracted consistently across tools.

steps.name: run_multiple_tools
steps.description: Execute at least two tools representing different mechanism classes rather than repeated runs of a single update rule.

requirements.mechanism_rule: Tools must represent different mechanism classes such as discrete, continuous, network, stochastic, or independent measurement.

steps.name: normalize_outputs
steps.description: Normalize observables before comparing tools so that agreement is not an artifact of scale choice.

steps.name: compare_agreement
steps.description: Compare normalized outputs and classify the degree of agreement between tools.

steps.name: classify_result
steps.description: Map the comparison outcome into the governed claim vocabulary.

steps.name: run_falsification_if_supported
steps.description: A result may not remain classified as supported unless it survives an explicit falsification pass.
steps.requirement: Run falsification_suite_v1 or falsification_suite_v1_cpp if the provisional outcome is supported.
steps.purpose: Prevent trivial or forced agreement from being mistaken for real support.

notes: This protocol governs agreement structure only and does not certify external truth.
Independent measurement layers should be used when required by validation_protocol_v2.json.
